Local-first terminal database workbench

Usage: dexo [COMMAND]

Commands:
  doctor       
  connections  
  completion   
  config       
  query        
  run          
  inspect      
  schema       
  export       
  import       
  explain      
  sessions     
  mcp          
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
